_source: bpmnlint 11.14.0 + bpmnlint-plugin-camunda-compat 2.61.0 (with @camunda/feel-builtins 1.4.1, @bpmn-io/feel-analyzer 0.3.0, @bpmn-io/lezer-feel 2.5.0; models read by bpmn-moddle 10.3.1, zeebe-bpmn-moddle 2.0.0 and modeler-moddle 0.2.0), config camunda-cloud-<version>, run once over these fixtures by the script described in camunda-compat.test.ts. Left out: executable-process, feel and agent-tool-documentation, which other BPMN Kit findings stand in for. `messages` has the plugin's messages for the rules whose wording BPMN Kit keeps.

agent-fromai-contract branchToA: fromAi() defines a tool input and cannot be used in a sequence flow condition. Define it in an input mapping on the tool's entry element.
agent-fromai-contract chainB: fromAi() is ignored here: only the tool's entry element defines AI inputs. Define it there and read the toolCall variable directly.
agent-fromai-contract outsideTool: fromAi() should only be used inside an agentic sub-process.
agent-fromai-contract plainTool: The "Plain" sub-process is not marked as agentic, so fromAi() has no effect.
agent-fromai-contract toolCasing: Wrong function name "FromAI". Use fromAi (case-sensitive).
fromAi() description must be a string literal: a quoted string describing what the agent should provide.
fromAi() description must be a string literal: a quoted string describing what the agent should provide.
fromAi() key must be a FEEL path starting with "toolCall.", not a List.
fromAi() key must be a FEEL path starting with "toolCall.", not a ParenthesizedExpression.
fromAi() key must be a FEEL path starting with "toolCall.", not a conditional expression. The connector requires a plain reference regardless of which branch would apply at runtime.
fromAi() key must be a FEEL path starting with "toolCall.", not a number.
fromAi() key must be a FEEL path starting with "toolCall.", not an arithmetic expression.
fromAi() key must be a FEEL path starting with "toolCall.", not null.
fromAi() key must be a single name under toolCall. Use toolCall.b instead of toolCall.a.b.
fromAi() key must start with "toolCall.". Got other.x.
fromAi() key must use dot notation, not bracket notation. Use toolCall.name instead of toolCall["name"].
agent-fromai-contract toolDuplicateKey: fromAi() key toolCall.q is declared more than once in this tool. Declare it once and reference it directly elsewhere.
agent-fromai-contract toolOutputFromAi: fromAi() defines a tool input and has no effect in an output mapping. Define it in an input mapping on the tool's entry element.
agent-fromai-contract toolSubStep: fromAi() is ignored here: only the tool's entry element defines AI inputs. Define it there and read the toolCall variable directly.
agent-fromai-contract toolUnmapped: fromAi() description must be a string literal: a quoted string describing what the agent should provide.
fromAi() key must be a FEEL path, not a string literal. Remove the quotes around "city".
fromAi() key must start with "toolCall.". Use toolCall.city instead of a bare name.
fromAi() requires a key argument: a FEEL path like toolCall.url.
agent-tool-output-key chainB: This overwrites the "toolCallResult" value set on "Fetch".
agent-tool-output-key chainC: This overwrites the "toolCallResult" value set on "chainB".
agent-tool-output-key forkedTool: Tool returns nothing to the agent. Set a "toolCallResult" (at minimum, note the task completed).
agent-tool-output-key legacyTool: Tool returns nothing to the agent. Set a "toolCallResult" (at minimum, note the task completed).
agent-tool-output-key toolNoResult: Tool returns nothing to the agent. Set a "toolCallResult" (at minimum, note the task completed).
